info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Operation Trade Confirmation Matching-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the matching of trade confirmations within market operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance in trading activities. Users can submit trade confirmations which the system validates against existing transactions. This service is essential for financial institutions and trading platforms that require reliable tracking and reconciliation of trade data. Typical consumers of this API include trading firms, brokers, and financial analysts looking to streamline their trade verification processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to match trade confirmations between parties to ensure accuracy and agreement on transactions. It facilitates the reconciliation process in trading operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit trade confirmation matching operations. It contains the necessary information and parameters for the system to process and match trade confirmations effectively.
